quote: Approximately 1 month after sowing, seedlings were transplanted to a paddy field at Takatsuki, Japan (34 51' 19'' N, 135 37' 51'' E) in 2015 and at Kizugawa, Japan (34 44' 03'' N, 135 50' 18'' E) in 2016. locus: cross-study determination over the studies' own design statements
quote: Determination, not a quotation: for each study below the sampling criterion is stated in the named evidence row, and in none of them is it the presence of disease. PRJNA306542 drought vs well-watered genotype screen (ev-luo2020-design, ev-ma2016-site). PRJNA609211 tillering/maturity stages and an ncRNA arm at the same facility (ev-xia2020t-site, ev-xia2020m-site). PRJNA746402 a maize MAGIC field trial sampled by genotype (ev-cai21b-site). PRJNA383416 a maize diversity panel sampled by genotype and tissue across three settings (ev-krem-field). PRJNA674915/PRJNA915033 grapevine sampled by rootstock, irrigation and phenological stage (ev-har21e-design). PRJNA726716 rice sampled by light and temperature transfer condition (ev-hashida-field). PRJNA510920 rice sampled by nitrogen and water dose at a fixed 49 DAS (ev-swift2019-f16). PRJDB7234 a paddy sampled bihourly for 24 h on sixteen fixed dates (ev-kashima-site). Sampling was therefore driven by genotype, imposed treatment, phenological stage or clock time. Any pathogen present is incidental to why the sample exists, which is the condition the cryptic co-infection hypothesis requires. Contrast disease-selected cohorts, where a plant was sampled BECAUSE it was symptomatic: those are a strong co-infection test set and an unusable prevalence denominator.

locus: Supplementary Table S2, columns year/month/day/hour (local JST)
quote: TableS2 carries year, month, day and hour per sample in local Japan time, giving 1,531 runs across 38 calendar days and 12 distinct local hours: the sixteen sets of bihourly 24 h sampling the Methods describe. The earlier kashima-year rule read the `year` column alone and wrote '2015' or '2016' over an archive field that already held a full timestamp for every run, so the series was flattened to two values. Local time is kept rather than the archive's UTC because 23:00 UTC is 08:00 the NEXT day in JST: a UTC stamp moves the solar hour and can move the calendar day, which matters for a diel series. kashima_runs.py REFUSES to write if any supplement day differs from the archive's UTC day by more than one; it currently passes on all 1,531, with 16:00 JST converting exactly to the recorded 07:00 UTC.

locus: determination over the paper's own description of the cohort
quote: Every sample in this compendium is described by the authors as 'Pst-infected': the cohort exists because the plants were showing yellow rust, collected under an explicit surveillance programme ('field pathogenomics', ev-ada21-surveillance). The sampling therefore conditioned on disease. This is the strongest available test of the cryptic co-infection hypothesis, because the authors reported Pst and only Pst, so any further pathogen in the reads is unreported by construction. It is simultaneously unusable as a prevalence denominator, for the same reason. Lab rows are marked 'inoculated' rather than 'disease-selected': there an archived isolate was deliberately applied to wheat, so disease is present by the experimenter's design, not by the sampler's choice.

locus: determination over the paper's own description of the cohort
quote: Every sample in this compendium is described by the authors as 'Pst-infected': the cohort exists because the plants were showing yellow rust, collected under an explicit surveillance programme ('field pathogenomics', ev-ada21-surveillance). The sampling therefore conditioned on disease. This is the strongest available test of the cryptic co-infection hypothesis, because the authors reported Pst and only Pst, so any further pathogen in the reads is unreported by construction. It is simultaneously unusable as a prevalence denominator, for the same reason. Lab rows are marked 'inoculated' rather than 'disease-selected': there an archived isolate was deliberately applied to wheat, so disease is present by the experimenter's design, not by the sampler's choice.

locus: Results, 'Environmental effects on gene expression in the field'
quote: We conducted two phases of field cultivation - one during the dry season (January-February) and one during the wet season (July-August) at the experimental rice station of the International Rice Research Institute (IRRI), Los Banos, Laguna, in the island of Luzon in the Philippines in 2013. The plants were cultivated in two adjacent fields typical of two different systems of rice cultivation. One field was cultivated following irrigated lowland practices: it was flooded with shallow water under constant irrigation and seedlings were transplanted to the field after being raised for 3 weeks in seedbeds (referred to as irrigated field). The second field was managed according to upland cultivation practices: it was rainfed, not irrigated and had been directly seeded.

locus: Results, sampling design
quote: To avoid the major shift in gene expression patterns induced by the transition to the flowering stage, which would confound our detection of environmental effects, we sampled rice leaf tissue during 1 month of vegetative growth (15 sampling timepoints, 2 days apart). Sampling was carried out 4 hr after sunrise to minimize circadian-driven transcriptional variation. Each sample included six young leaves, each from a different plant, to minimize variation in individual plant microenvironment. ... Collection took, on average, 13 min. RECONCILIATION: the archive's 30 collection dates are exactly 15 per season, two days apart - dry 2013-01-25 to 2013-02-22 (119 runs) and wet 2013-07-22 to 2013-08-19 (120 runs), totalling the deposited 239.

PRJNA609211 tillering/maturity stages and an ncRNA arm at the same facility (ev-xia2020t-site, ev-xia2020m-site). PRJNA746402 a maize MAGIC field trial sampled by genotype (ev-cai21b-site). PRJNA383416 a maize diversity panel sampled by genotype and tissue across three settings (ev-krem-field). PRJNA674915/PRJNA915033 grapevine sampled by rootstock, irrigation and phenological stage (ev-har21e-design). PRJNA726716 rice sampled by light and temperature transfer condition (ev-hashida-field). PRJNA510920 rice sampled by nitrogen and water dose at a fixed 49 DAS (ev-swift2019-f16). PRJDB7234 a paddy sampled bihourly for 24 h on sixteen fixed dates (ev-kashima-site). quote: Determination, not a quotation: for each study below the sampling criterion is stated in the named evidence row, and in none of them is it the presence of disease. PRJNA306542 drought vs well-watered genotype screen (ev-luo2020-design, ev-ma2016-site). PRJNA383416 a maize diversity panel sampled by genotype and tissue across three settings (ev-krem-field). PRJNA674915/PRJNA915033 grapevine sampled by rootstock, irrigation and phenological stage (ev-har21e-design). PRJNA726716 rice sampled by light and temperature transfer condition (ev-hashida-field). PRJNA510920 rice sampled by nitrogen and water dose at a fixed 49 DAS (ev-swift2019-f16). PRJDB7234 a paddy sampled bihourly for 24 h on sixteen fixed dates (ev-kashima-site). Sampling was therefore driven by genotype, imposed treatment, phenological stage or clock time. locus: Materials and methods, 'RNA extraction, cDNA library preparation, and RNA sequencing'
quote: 'The DNA-free total RNA was subjected to ribosomal RNA depletion by Illumina Ribo-Zero rRNA Removal Kit (Plant Leaf) ... Strand-specific cDNA libraries were prepared from ribosomal depleted RNA using the NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep kit.' THIS IS THE ONLY RIBODEPLETED PROJECT IN THE COHORT; every other is polyA-selected. A ribodepleted library retains non-polyadenylated and bacterial transcripts that polyA selection removes, so the microbial FRACTION of reads is systematically higher here for reasons of chemistry rather than biology. Fungal mRNA is polyadenylated and captured by both methods, so these runs remain usable for fungal detection, but any comparison expressed as a percentage of classified reads is invalid against the rest of the cohort. CLAUDE.md's existing rule - report read counts, not percentages - is what makes them safe to include. The archive's library_selection reads 'cDNA' on all 151 and does not distinguish the chemistries.

locus: Materials and methods, 'Data and tissue collection for physiological, metabolic, and transcriptome analyses'
quote: Maize (Z. mays) inbred lines B73 and Mo17 were grown in a randomized complete block factorial design with 3 replications and 2 treatments at SIMPSON RESEARCH FARM, PENDLETON, SC, USA, IN THE SUMMER OF 2017. In each block, each inbred line was grown in two 6-row plots with row and row-to-row distances of 4.57 and 0.762 m, respectively, and the 2 treatments, pollinated and nonpollinated, were randomly assigned to the plots. The primary and secondary ears of all plants in all plots were covered with shoot bags before silk emergence, and the treatments were started at 0 DAA characterized by silks emergence in >=80% of the plants... Data collection and sampling were performed on the leaf at 2 nodes above the ear-bearing node of 2 competitive randomly chosen plants at 3-d intervals from 0 to 45 DAA... The leaf samples consisting of 30 cm of the leaf blade excluding midrib, ligule, and sheath were chopped into small pieces, flash frozen.
